## POST `/api/instances/replicationSession/name:{name}/action/failback`

**Tier:** T1–T3 (action: read its description)  

Fail back a replication session. This can be applied on a replication session that is failed over. Fail back will synchronize the changes done to the original destination back to original source site and will restore the original direction of session. The allowFullCopy or forceFullCopy option is needed when a replication session goes out of sync due to a fault. Both allowFullCopy and forceFullCopy cannot be set simultaneously. If the session has no common base snapshot and neither allowFullCopy nor forceFullCopy is specified, a full copy will be performed using the same behavior as when…

## POST `/api/instances/replicationSession/name:{name}/action/failover`

**Tier:** T1–T3 (action: read its description)  

Fail over a replication session. Note that if a failover occurs and data is written to the new source (original destination), new snaps are taken, and finally a failback occurs: then those snaps will get replicated to the new destination (original source). However, we maintain the local retention for the original source and the remote retention for the original destination. If the same scenario occurs but a resume is requested instead of failback (essentially switching the replication direction), then the local and remote retentions are switched so that the local retention policy is applied…

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | User-specified replication session name. |

_4 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Request body** (required): `inline`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sync` | boolean | Indicates whether to sync the source and destination resources before failing over the asynchronous replication session or whether to keep them in sync after failing over the synchronous replication session. true -… |
| `force` | boolean | Indicates to skip pre-checks on file system(s) replication sessions of a NAS server when a replication failover is issued from the source NAS server. true - skip pre-check. false - Do not skip pre-check. |

**Responses:** `204` No Content

## POST `/api/instances/replicationSession/name:{name}/action/precheck`

**Tier:** T1–T3 (action: read its description)  

Precheck the replication session. Check for a common base snap of a sync replication session, and if it is a NAS Server session, also check each included filesystem replication session for a common base snap . A common base snap is identified by the corresponding source and destination snap ids for the replicated common base snap . The result will include each common base snap found, which may be an empty list.

| `name` | path | string | yes | User-specified replication session name. |

## POST `/api/types/replicationSession/instances`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Create a replication session. Replication can be configured between like type resources. Interface options are optional and applicable to inter-array replication.

_4 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Request body** (required): `inline`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `remoteSystem` | object | Unique identifier of the remote system in the replication session, as defined by the remoteSystem resource type. |
| `srcSPAInterface` | object | (Applies to remote replication) Replication interface for the source SPA. |
| `srcSPBInterface` | object | (Applies to remote replication) Replication interface for the source SPB. |
| `dstSPAInterface` | object | (Applies to remote replication) Replication interface for the destination SPA. |
| `dstSPBInterface` | object | (Applies to remote replication) Replication interface for the destination SPB. |
| `srcResourceId` | string | Unique identifier of the source resource. |
| `dstResourceId` | string | Unique identifier of the destination resource. |
| `maxTimeOutOfSync` | integer (signed int[32(minutes)]) | Maximum time to wait before the system syncs the source and destination resources. Value of -1 specifies that automatic sync is not performed. |
| `autoInitiate` | boolean | (Applies to replication sessions with manual synchronization.) Indicates whether to perform the first replication sync (a full sync) automatically. Values are: true - Perform the first replication sync automatically.… |
| `name` | string | Name of the replication session |
| `members` | array of `lunMemberReplication` | (Applies to replication sessions for Consistency groups) Specify ALL member luns' pairing between source and destination resource of the session. Treat Consistency groups as a single entity when they are replicated. |
| `hourlySnapReplicationPolicy` | `snapReplicationPolicy` | Describes or specifies the policy for replicating either hourly or daily scheduled snaps of the source storageResource . |
| `dailySnapReplicationPolicy` | `snapReplicationPolicy` | Describes or specifies the policy for replicating either hourly or daily scheduled snaps of the source storageResource . |
| `replicateExistingSnaps` | boolean | Whether or not to replicate snapshots already existing on the resource (one-time option at session creation time). Each replica of these snaps will inherit the source snap retention policy. |
| `noAsyncSnapReplication` | boolean | Whether or not snap replication is enabled in asynchronous replication session. When enabled, snap replication is controlled by snap replication policy setting or user action. |
| `cascadeReplicatedSnap` | boolean | Whether or not to replicate snap in the cascade replication session. When enabled, snap will be automatically replicated in this replication session when it is replicated from the inbound async replication session. |
| `srcCommonBaseSnap` | object | Snapshot that used as common baseline snap for async replication session source side. |
| `dstCommonBaseSnapId` | string | Unique identifier of the destination snapshot that used as common baseline snap for async replication session destination side. |
| `skipSnapSignatureCheck` | boolean | Force to use snapshot as common baseline snap for async replication session. |
| `enableCommonBaseAutoSearch` | boolean | Enable auto searching and pairing common base. |
| `overwriteDestination` | boolean | For LUN/CG replications, enabling this option, which defaults to false, will allow replication copying all of source data and overwriting any data already on the destination LUN(s) in the initial-copy. |

**Responses:** `201` Created body fields: `@base`, `updated`, `links`, `content`
